notes.title: The Ancient Lands (Version .0.6.2.4)
notes.notes:
Here is a end of the week update to the game. Includes a new enemy unit, new building, and various are changes. Below is the list of changes and additions.

[b]Additions/Features:[/b]
*When units are selected, an outline will now be created around them
*There are now armor and weapon upgrades in the game. The Smith is the building
that is tasked with upgrades
*A new enemy unit, the Wanderer (Plains exclusive enemy), has been added to the game. The Wanderer is a short ranged entity that has dabbled in the powers of lightning magic. Each attack will
stun your units for (1 1/6 second). 
Attacks against units with higher armor versus its damage will recieve a smaller stun time (1/3 second).
*A new building, the Stone Trap, has been added to the game. The Stone Trap is hidden with magic when placed on the ground. Enemies that pass over it take damage and are unable to move or attack.
However, the trap takes damage as well.
*Global death cues have been implemented into the game. Each of your units that die will let off a death sound. Each unit has a different death sounds except the two pike men and Warrior and ShieldBearer
*When you click on friendly units now, they now talk.

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
*Colossus health has decreased from 1900 to 1750
*Briki attack rate has been slowed from 1.5 attacks/s to .85 attacks/s
*Wall health(Wood) increased from 500 to 700 and (Stone) increased from 1000 to 1200 and armor from 2 to 5
*House population(Normal) provided decreased from 8 to 3 and (Stone) from 8 to 4
*Most of the buildings has had an increase in health and armor
*Maugh health increased to 510, damage to 45, and armor to 7
*Warrior health increased from 265 to 360 and armor from 4 to 5
*Polymorph spell size increased and reduced power cost from 150 to 110
*Pikeman health increased from 190 to 240, damage from 13 to 17, and armor from 1 to 2
*Did an overhaul change in how often enemies will come to attack. Enemy attacks are now spaced out and gives you more room to breath.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.notes: Hey everyone. The game has seen many changes the last little bit. I was wondering on what you all think of it in its current state. I'll be happy to listen to what you all have to say.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands (Version .0.6.0.0)
notes.notes:
This is a pretty good sized update. Got two new enemy units in the new map, the Plains. We have a new friendly unit for you to use as well as some reworked sprites for buildings and units. In the next following update will feature a new offensive building and the third unique enemy for the new map as well. I got the list of changes, additions, and bug fixes below.

[b]Tweaks[/b]
*The Queue Box has been organized into neat columns

[b]Additions/Features[/b]
*A new map, the Plains, has been added to the game. A wide open land with a good amount of trees and berry bushes, but
offers little protection due to the decreased number of mountains
*A new building, the Smith, has been added to the game. It is the first advancement building in the game.
It unlocks Warriors and Shield Bearers
*A new enemy unit, Skeleton Warrior, has been added to the game. They replace normal 
skeletons after so many waves
*A new enemy unit, Shujaa Mweusi (Plains exclusive enemy), has been added to the game. They replace the Hooded Being. As the game progresses, they gradually increase in health, damage, and armor
*A new enemy unit, Bush Spider (Plains exclusive enemy), has been added to the game. They replace the Giant Spider a little bit later into the game. They have a one time use ranged attack for additional upfront damage on top of their first melee hit
*A new friendly unit, the Colossus, has been added to the game. They are high damaging sponges. They are trained from the Sanctuary and they require the Forge to train
*Houses can be upgraded to Stone Houses for additional income. Press U when selected to upgrade
*A description of an enemy unit now displays when an enemy unit is being tracked
*You can now see the total upkeep cost of your army
*You can now see how much gold is generated daily

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
*Did some more enemy buffs
*Reduced the number of stone deposits that are spawned
*Pike Man gold cost increased from 50 to 90
*The Forge now requires the Smith to be constructed
*Warrior requires the Smith to be trained
*Shield Bearer requires the Smith to be trained
*The Cavalry is a very strong unit with its damage output and considering this fact;
they now require both the Stable and the Forge in order to be trained
*Fairy now requires the Forge and Sanctuary to be built in order to be trained
*Shock Healers require the Temple to be built in order to be trained
*Stone Launchers drain 1.5 stone per shot instead of .25 now and require the Smith to be built to be constructed
*When a Greater Werewolf spawns, they have a chance to howl and summon in 3 more Minor Werewolves
*Amount of starting Prayer decreased from 100 to 40
*Amount of gold needed by each unit has been increased considerably
*Houses provide +80 Gold/Day instead of +40 Gold/Day
*Amount of food needed to train most of the soldiers has increased
*Shock Healer healing wave cannot overlap, but healing amount increased from 10.8 to 25.2

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
*Fixed an issue where the Spell Ward would not be repaired when damage is taken

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.notes:
Just fixing some issues with health and some general adjustments

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
*Buffed up some of the enemies in the game

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

notes.title: The Ancient Lands (Version .0.5.7.2)
notes.notes:
This is an update mainly regarding power production and various power costs. Below is the list of overall changes:

[b]Tweaks[/b]
*Projectiles have been fixed to where they now stop when the game is paused like they suppose to

[b]Additions/Features[/b]
*The damage of enemy units is now tracked due to possible damage changes regarding the new enemy unit
*A new enemy, the Corrupted Earth (Mountain exclusive enemy), has been put into the game. They are the replacement for the StoGolem after you progress so far in.
They have more health and armor and they have an unique ability. The less health they have, the more damage they deal
*Final wave music has been added

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
*The rate at which you gather Prayer has been decreased quite a bit. Conserve the usage and make the most out of spell usage
*Stop Time Spell cost increased from 40 to 80
*Repel Evil Spell cost increased from 50 to 90
*Fortitude Spell size has increased and spell cost decreased from 125 to 75
*Fireburst Spell cost increased from 100 to 200
*Villager training time slightly increased
*The Prayer Tower no longer requires Prayer to shoot. It now costs some upfront Prayer to be built instead
*Prayer Tower damage decreased from 250 to 140
*Minor Defenders require 200 gold now to train and reduced Prayer cost from 20 to 1
*Maughs require 300 gold now to train and reduced Prayer cost from 25 to 3
*Brikis require 600 gold now to train and reduced Prayer cost from 60 to 7
*Guardian Spell cost decreased from 90 to 20 and summons 5 guardians instead of 3 now
*The amount of stone deposits that are spawned on both maps have been decreased
*Polymorph Spell cost decreased from 250 to 150 and spell size increased
*Cavalry health increased from 700 to 850, and damage from 58 to 85
*Armored Pike Man health increased from 450 to 700, damage from 38 to 44, and armor from 10 to 15
*Fairy health increased from 1000 to 1100, damage from 75 to 90, and armor from 13 to 21
*Effect of Fortitude Spell increased from 15 to 25

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
*Fixed the outline created by the Prayer Tower when selected
*Fixed a bug that the Sanctuary gives housing

notes.title: The Ancient Lands (Version .0.5.5.8)
notes.notes:
Here is another The Ancient Lands update everyone. I hope you all had a good week and have a blessed Sunday.

[b]Tweaks:[/b]
*Did some final readjustments on the Spell Ward regarding spell placement
*Whenever a Watch Tower is destroyed and there are Archers in them, the Archers
are now able to go into other towers unlike before

[b]Additions/Features:[/b]
*When a building is selected, an outline will be created showing that it is selected
*You can now destroy buildings at will to free up space if needed. Pressing Delete
when a building is selected (Except the Village Center) will destroy the building
and give you 50% resources back

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
*The Warrior damage has been increased from 27 to 35 and gold cost from 120 to 140
*The Shield Bearer is now classified as a higher level solider and requires 450 gold to train
instead of 280
*Armored Pike Man gold cost raised from 550 to 725
*Cavalry gold cost raised from 750 to 950
*Stable cost gold has been raised from 600 to 1400 since it grants access to the
powerful Cavalry and has been regarded as a unit progression building
*Forge gold cost massively increased due to the fact it has the valuable Armored Pike Man,
 the AoE damaging Firework, and it is classified as a unit progression building

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
*Fixed a bug where if an enemy unit destroys a wall, it destroys the nearest unit or building
*Fixed a bug that if you try to construct the Spell Ward and something is in the way, it
changes your building selection to the Stable

notes.title: The Ancient Lands (Version .0.5.5.0)
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas everyone. Here is the new update to the game with version .0.5.5.0. There are quite a few new additions and changes so I hope you all enjoy. Below is the list of changes:

[b]Additions/Features:[/b]
*When you press 1-4 to change tasks for newly trained villagers, your village center
will have an icon that displays determining which resource is being sought for
*There is now a list on the right side that displays how many of each
military unit you currently have
*There is now an ending for completing all of the waves
*There is now a stats screen that pops up when you triumph over evil or if the
darkness consumes you (pathetic text that shows up when you die has been replaced by this). The
stats screen shows: The Map Name, on the left(Fallen Humans and how many of each soldier has
died), on the right(Fallen Creatures and how many of each creature has died), and whether
you survived (VICTORY) or if you perished (DEFEAT)
*A new supportive building, the Spell Ward, has been added to the game. The Spell Ward
is a building that auto casts Healing and Boost Spells when enemies are nearby. The
Spells that are cast have no impact on your current Prayer
*A new enemy, the Rock Slinger (Mountain exclusive enemy) has been added to the game. It is
a replacement for the Needle Neck. They are stronger and have a faster attack rate and thus
are more dangerous

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
*Slightly decreased the spawn points needed for some of the creatures (More creatures spawned)
*Increased the gold needed per day for the majority of units by some and quite a bit
for others
*Increased gold cost of Fairy from 1500 to 2000
*Repairing buildings now require resources needed based on a small portion of the original
cost of the building
*Houses provide only +8 to population instead of +10 now
*Decreased the number of mountains that spawn in The Forest
*Vampires now drain 50% of their damage dealt into health
*Vampire health increased from 830 to 910 and armor from 6 to 10
*The final boss's health has been massively increased
*TailRipper (Boss enemy before final wave) health increased from 5000 to 11000 and
armor from 0 to 5
*Mangled Lizard (1st boss enemy) health increased from 3000 to 4500
*Houses provide 40 gold per day instead of 20

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
*Fixed an issue that when villagers tasked with food or wood jobs run out of the resource,
they would go to the right corner of the map. Now, they will stay near the Village Center
*Fixed an issue that if villagers are somehow pushed into Watch Towers with Archers in them,
the Archers in them would be pushed out.
*Fixed a bug where the Stable could not be repaired

notes.title: The Ancient Lands (Version .0.5.0.4)
notes.notes:
This small update has destroyed a few more bugs and some minor changes.
[b]Tweaks:[/b]
*Made a fix that the DeathPault (Late game enemy siege unit) cannot fire if it is
outside the map. It now has to been so many pixels in to begin firing

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
*The Mist's (Late game enemy unit) speed has been doubled
*It takes a little bit longer for the Temple to generate Prayer now
*When constructing walls, the wall will stay selected so you can keep building, so you
don't have to continually hold down the L key, but the L key is a fast way to select the
wall without having to point your mouse down to select it

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
*Fixed a bug when villagers go outside the map, they still continue moving after 
the game is paused
*Fixed a bug that when villagers get stuck inside of Watch Towers or Stables, 
they could not get out
*Fixed a bug where the Sanctuary could not be repaired
*Fixed a bug that when you have troops assigned to a defensive zone and when enemies
are present, deleting the zone would crash the game

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.notes: *Fixed a bug that when you construct the Prayer Tower, it just makes the Prayer Icon image.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands (.0.5.0.0)
notes.notes:
Here is the next big update for The Ancient Lands. Below is the list of things that have been done:
[b]Tweaks:[/b]
*The Tutorial has had a complete overhaul and provides a better understanding
of the game's mechanics
*Redone the Credit and Controls screen on the menu
*A lot of code organization has been done under the hood
*Did some changes to the GUI
*When you pause in game, the menu options have been moved down to the lower right now

[b]Removed:[/b]
*As of right now, the save system has temporarily been took out, but will be back in a
later update.

[b]Additions:[/b]
*A new map called Mountains has been added. A slightly more challenging map than the Forest with
less available resources and an introduction to unique monsters 
*Granite Saber (Mountain exclusive enemy) has been added to the game
*Briki (Friendly unit) has been added to the game. Brikis are ranged beings that are from
the sky and their projectiles have armor breaking properties. Brikis are trained from the Sanctuary
*Polymorph Spell has been added to the game. This power turns enemies
that walk into the spell into cows. Does not affect boss units

[b]Balance Changes:[/b]
*Workers in stone deposits can now continue working when enemies are present.
*Workers train time decreased some to allow faster training
*The Unit Information Box will now keep track of current armor due to the new
armor breaking ability added to the game
*Difficulty progression has been decreased around 25%-30%
*All walls are now treated as gates. Any villager can now walk through when needed while
enemies cannot

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
*Fixed a bug when constructing buildings that you can exploit and get resources by simply
trying to build over multiple buildings
*Fixed it to where you cannot accidentally select your troops through the GUI at
the bottom of the screen

The next update will feature the rest of the unique monsters for the Mountains.
Thank you for your time and thanks for playing.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands (Second Part of Major Update)
notes.notes:
Hello everybody. The second part of the major update will be occurring next week. The update
will feature more maps, more enemies, more units (Friendly and Hostile) and more buildings.

There will also be a few graphical changes that occur on this update.

Thank you for your time.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands (Version .0.3.8.1)
notes.notes:
Update to the game, The Ancient Lands to version .0.3.8.1.

*Fixed a bug that when you load, gates could not be walked through by village people.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands (Version .0.3.7.8)
notes.notes:
Update of The Ancient Lands to version .0.3.7.8.
[b]Tweaks[/b]
*The Pike Man, Warrior, Shield Bearer, Archer, and Armored Pike Man health pool has been increased.
*The Pike Man and Warrior damage has been increased.
*Changed the key to load the game from K to F1 to avoid accidentally hitting the key when placing down walls.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands (Version .0.3.5.0)
notes.notes:
This is an update to The Ancient Lands to version .0.3.5.0.
Here are the changes:
*Combat system has been reworked. Units will not directly collide with each other when engaging
in combat, but will instead start combat at a small slight distance to prevent pushing each
other.
*The DeathPault will not start firing until it enters the playable area.
*Fixed a display in the unit display box showing the real name of the unit.
*Walls will now display their health when the health HUD is enabled.
*Fixed the overlapping of displays from the Queue Box when separate buildings with buildable 
units are selected.
*The Sanctuary now has a working Queue Box.

notes.title: Upcoming Update - The Ancient Lands
notes.notes:
Sorry it has been awhile everybody. But, I am back to updating The Ancient Lands. I owe the community an apology for the lack of content the last several months.

Updates will be made starting on November 23 on a bi-weekly basis to add more content as well as to make various changes to The Ancient Lands.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.notes:
The Ancient Lands has updated to version 0.3.0.0. 

* Left clicking will bring up the closest enemy target and display their current stats.
* Slight change to combat.
* While in game and when the game is paused, you can click on controls to bring up controls screen instead of having to go back to title screen and going to controls that way. You can also press Backspace to bring up the control screen without having to pause.
* Fixed a few typo errors and re-devised some of the descriptions of buildings, powers, and units.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.notes: The update that was going to occur on June 26 has now been postponed to June 30 due to a few ideas I had come to mind. There will be a little extra content to the game as a result.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.notes:
There is going to be a scheduled update to the game on June 26.

This update is going to change some visual aspects of the game as well as add some new features to the game. New features like the ability to show stats when a unit is hovered over, slightly change the way combat works, as well as other features that will be addressed later upon update day.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.notes: This update is fixing a bug I found within the game regarding saving for a specific unit and crashing the game.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.notes:
Sorry about the late update today. I planned on doing this update much earlier, but some life situations popped up. This is the release of version 0.2.2.5.
[b]Additions[/b]
* A simple save system was developed. It still has some kinks to work out, but it is functional. When you are in the game. You can press tab and the save game option will pop up. Clicking it will save your progress and while you are in a game, you can press K to load your last saved progress.
* Stables have been added to the game. They are required to build Cavalry units.
* A new building, the Sanctuary has been added. This building trains units regarding only prayer.
They have no upkeep of gold or food to worry about.
* Minor Defenders can now be trained (They spawn from the Guardians Spell)
* Maughs has been added to the game. They can be trained from the Sanctuary.
They are destructive units that deals AoE damage when destroyed.
* A new power, Fireburst Spell has been added. It has the power to deal immense fire damage and stun any enemy unit caught within its grasp.

[b]Animals[/b]
* On 5/31/20 (tomorrow), I will update the animals into the game. This took more time than I expected it would take. But expect to see animals in the tomorrow update.

[b]Keybinding[/b]
* This is gonna be a hard thing to implement. The way the gaming engine I am using works, it is gonna take awhile. But expect to see this in feature in future updates.

notes.title: The Ancient Lands
notes.notes:
This is a surprise update. This includes some of the things I am working on toward version 0.2.2.5.
[b]Additions[/b]
* Ability to toggle health bars on and off
* Ability to toggle HUD on and off (Powers are still shown)

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
* Enemies are now stronger, but there are a little less of them
* Villagers in stone deposits can only mine when enemies are not present
* Prayer Tower now deals 150 damage instead of 100
* Spawn chance increased from 65 to 75

[b]Tweaks[/b]
* Tutorial has been reworked to provide a better understanding
* Info about unit gold costs are now shown when you hover to train units
* More info is revealed throughout regarding certain units or structures
* Menu shows up when you die
* Did some general optimization to make things run more efficiently
